name: Developers portal content revision
description:
> [!NOTE]
> Jira: [https://shoptet.atlassian.net/browse/FRONTEND-1643](https://shoptet.atlassian.net/browse/FRONTEND-1643)

We provide information to our Partners on our portal [https://developers.shoptet.com/](https://developers.shoptet.com/). This site consists of updated posts (like a blog post) and articles that are not always up-to-date. Another minor flaw is an outdated design that doesn’t resemble modern documentation/developers portals.

This initiative aims to raise these topics and, hopefully, outcome with a better Shoptet Developers portal.

The perspective solution for the new Developers portal is [https://docusaurus.io/that](https://docusaurus.io/that) we used previously for Sofa and now for Addon Repository documentation [https://addon-repository-github-app.vercel.app/](https://addon-repository-github-app.vercel.app/).
